# Release Upgrade Summary (2026)

**Source:** https://help.zscaler.com/zpa/release-upgrade-summary-2026
**Captured:** 2026-10-18 via help_capture.py (article payload, canonical text)
**Revision:** node 1534305, revision 3243020

---

This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements per Zscaler cloud for the Zscaler Admin Console. To see scheduled maintenance updates for your cloud, visit the Trust Portal.
When Zscaler cloud and the Zscaler Admin Console updates are deploying, some functionality will not be available until the deployment process completes.
